overclaims: Cruise confirmed recurring remote-assistance requests, roughly every four to five miles, and assistance sessions covering 2–4% of operating time.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, outcome and citation are fine. The rationale changes the CEO's figure. He said cars were 'remotely assisted (RA) 2-4% of the time on average, in complex urban environments'. The rationale calls this 'assistance sessions covering 2–4% of operating time', which drops the urban-environment qualifier and makes it a whole-fleet share of operating time. The word 'sessions' is also not in the evidence. Fix: restore the qualifier and use the evidence's own wording.
